extracted.intended_audience: Scientists interested in program officer / Health Scientist Administrator positions at NIGMS (Division of Biophysics, Biomedical Technology, and Computational Biosciences)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for applicants to two Program Officer (Health Scientist Administrator) positions in the NIGMS Division of Biophysics, Biomedical Technology, and Computational Biosciences, describing duties, desired expertise, and application logistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program management responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: "Responsible for scientific and administrative management of a portfolio of research grants, and will stimulate, plan, advise, direct, and evaluate program activities related to their field of expertise."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This describes the core duties expected of the successful applicants: stewardship of grant portfolios and active program-level leadership (stimulate, plan, advise, direct, evaluate).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bioinformatics & Computational Biology Branch expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: The Bioinformatics and Computational Biology Branch supports bioinformatics and computational approaches that join biology with the computer sciences, engineering, mathematics, biostatistics, and physics. "Applicants should have experience in developing and/or applying computational approaches to biomedical problems."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Areas of interest explicitly include (but are not limited to) computational and mathematical biology, bioinformatics, biostatistics, biomedical data science, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. Candidates should demonstrate relevant technical experience in these domains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biophysics Branch expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: The Biophysics Branch supports research that applies techniques and principles derived from the physical sciences to examine structures and structure-function relationships in biology. "The position requires stewardship of grant awards related to development or applications of computational molecular modeling for biophysics, biochemistry, or drug discovery."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should have broad expertise in one or more of the following areas: biophysics, computational molecular modeling, or applied mathematics. Expect to manage awards tied to computational molecular modeling and related applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Familiarity with NIH extramural funding (desirable)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Familiarity with NIH extramural funding as an applicant, reviewer, or NIH scientific administrator is a plus."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While not strictly required, prior experience interacting with NIH funding mechanisms—having applied for grants, served as a reviewer, or worked within NIH extramural administration—strengthens an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication skills (essential)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Outstanding written and oral communication skills are essential."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must demonstrate strong ability to communicate clearly in writing and speech, reflecting the role's need for program communication, stakeholder interaction, and possibly representation of program interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appointment route, grade levels, and eligibility distinctions
rubrics_metrics.description: "The positions are being advertised as part of the NIH global recruitment for Health Scientist Administrators. There will be two GS-12/13/14 Health Scientist Administrator (Program Officer) vacancy announcements: one for federal employees (candidates with current or former federal employment status) and one for the public (candidates without such status)."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must choose the correct vacancy announcement based on federal employment status. The advertised GS grades indicate the potential pay/level; consult the vacancy announcements for grade-specific qualification requirements. Announcements open May 17 and close May 26 (per the post).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided application resources and contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: In preparing an application, the webpage on applying for scientific administration jobs at NIGMS and the NIGMS tip sheet for global recruitments may offer useful information. "For additional information about these positions, visit our job vacancies webpage to view the announcements. We encourage all interested candidates to contact Dorothy Beckett, Paul Brazhnik, or Fei Wang with questions about the positions."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult the linked NIGMS guidance pages and tip sheet for practical application advice, review the official vacancy announcements on the job vacancies page for formal requirements, and may contact the named staff for position-specific questions.
